verdict.rationale: Twenty documents native custom dashboards with real-time widgets for pipeline metrics, team performance, and KPIs. Charts are configurable by type, data source, filters, aggregation, and grouping, and are shared at workspace level in a resizable grid, so reporting happens in-app without exporting to a spreadsheet. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of activity (emails/calls/tasks) and conversion-rate/funnel reporting, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboard depth.
